requirement: This code should implement a state machine for resetting two axes in a control system, handling inputs for each axis (Axis1 and Axis2 of type AXIS_REF), and a boolean signal (bExecute) to start the reset process. The outputs are three boolean states: bDone (reset complete), bBusy (reset in progress), and bError (error present). The state machine transitions through four main states: idle (0), reading axis status (1), executing reset (2), and completion (3). In the idle state, the system waits for bExecute to be true to initialize and move to the reading state. In the reading state, it checks the status of both axes and moves to the reset state if both are valid. In the reset state, it attempts to reset both axes and checks for errors; if no errors are found, it sets bDone to true, otherwise sets bError to true. The completion state resets the flags and state if bExecute is false.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DualAxisReset
VAR_INPUT
	Axis1			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//轴1引用
	Axis2			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//轴2引用
	bExecute		:	BOOL;				//执行复位信号
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bDone			:	BOOL;				//复位完成
	bBusy			:	BOOL;				//复位进行中
	bError			:	BOOL;				//错误标志
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个用于控制系统中重置两个轴的状态机，处理每个轴的输入（Axis1 和 Axis2 类型为 AXIS_REF）以及一个布尔信号（bExecute）以启动重置过程。输出有三个布尔状态：bDone（重置完成）、bBusy（重置进行中）和 bError（存在错误）。状态机通过四个主要状态进行转换：空闲（0）、读取轴状态（1）、执行重置（2）和完成（3）。在空闲状态，系统等待 bExecute 为真以初始化并移动到读取状态。在读取状态，它检查两个轴的状态，并在两者都有效时移动到重置状态。在重置状态，它尝试重置两个轴并检查错误；如果没有发现错误，它将 bDone 设置为真，否则将 bError 设置为真。完成状态在 bExecute 为假时重置标志和状态。
